title: Multi-Window Lifecycle
description: Creating, positioning, and closing OS windows.
body: Creating and destroying the windows a detached surface lives in. Every window loads the same index.html with a ?window=<label> query — no second frontend, no reduced build: a detached window mounts the same WindowRoot, state, title bar, switcher bar and panel as the main one, which makes it feel like the same application. Labels are opaque win-<n> values minted by ShellState, and Tauri scopes capabilities per window label.
